name: Token Defaults
description: Set up rewrites for tokens not found.
project_description:
Allows a token to be given a default value in the event of no value being found. This can be altered per content type.

Installation: after installing this module it is configured from the Token Defaults configuration page at admin/config/search/token_default. Add a token default by supplying a label, the token pattern string to be replaced, and the default string to use when a replacement cannot be found; optionally scope it to a single node bundle.

Known issues: there are no restrictions on what can be entered for the token pattern string (single-token validation is not enforced); there are no automated tests; only a single content type can be selected per default via the UI; and there is no way to restrict a default to the context of the replacement (for example, pathauto only).
